data.name: CommandLineHelp
data.value:
UltimateRDP.exe [options] [file.rdp]
Connection. Without a .rdp file, --server is needed; with one, these options win over its keys. --server <host>: the computer, a host name or an IP address --port <n>: the port, 3389 by default --user <name>, --domain <name>: the account --remoteapp <program>: a RemoteApp program, ||Name or Name for a published alias, a path with \, / or : on the server --remoteapp-name <name>, --remoteapp-args <text>: its name and its arguments --gateway <host>: a Remote Desktop Gateway
Display and devices. --multimon on|off: every monitor in full screen --scale <100 to 500>: the scale factor, in percent --windows-keys local|remote|fullscreen: where the Windows key combinations go --clipboard on|off, --drives on|off, --printers on|off: what the session shares --audio local|remote|off: where the sound plays
Start. --ask-credentials: ask for the password at every connection --show: show the main window, also for a RemoteApp program --hidden: keep the main window hidden, also for a desktop --help, /?: this list
There is no option for a password: Windows uses the credential saved for the server, or asks for the password.
